.kitchen
Pal paysam resipi | chaval ki khir | rais paysam vistrit photo aur vidiyo resipi ke satha. yah chaval aur dudh se bana ek paranprik, samriddh aur malaeedar bhartiy klasik dezart resipi hai. dakshin bharat men, yah aam taur par tyohar ya kisi bhi avsar par banaya jata hai. yah kisi bhi any dudh-aadharit khir ya mithaee ki tulna men bahut hi saral aur aasan khir resipi hai aur ise mul samagri ke sath banaya ja sakta hai.
